questions.stem: In a circuit, an LED glows only when its longer wire is connected to the positive terminal of the battery. Why is this so?
choices: The LED is designed to allow current to pass in only one direction

questions.stem: If a student uses a copper wire with its insulator covering intact in a circuit, what will happen?

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using insulators in electrical circuits?
choices: To allow current to flow easily
To increase the resistance of the circuit
To reduce the voltage of the circuit
questions.solution: Insulators are used to prevent electric shocks because they do not allow electric current to pass through them, making them safe to handle.
